about: Business licence for people living outside the UAE who want to start a business in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED licensing requirements page on the checked date. Licences are applied for through the ADDED eServices on TAMM, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For individuals living outside the country who want to start a business in Abu Dhabi
channels: ADDED eServices on TAMM (tamm.abudhabi) or the TAMM app
ADDED contact line 800555, 8 am to 3 pm, or contact@tamm.abudhabi
